about: The Connect an AI screen, then Check again while the check can't get through. Staged in the page: the cached engine read reports the fixture's fake engine as unavailable, which brings up the screen, and the fresh check (/api/instances?fresh=1) answers 503.

steps.eval: (() => { let el = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.includes('Check again')); while (el && !(el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1 && getComputedStyle(el).overflowY !== 'visible')) el = el.parentElement; if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; return Boolean(el); })()
